items.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
items.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
items.description: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

items.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
items.description: Lev Schlosberg is found guilty of "discrediting" Russia's army - a verdict he condemns as punishment for his political position.

items.title: French PM heckled over wildfire response as blazes continue across Europe
items.description: The prime minister announced on Monday €12m worth of aid to French regions that had been worst affected by the fires.

items.title: Mushroom murderer Erin Patterson is appealing - here's what you need to know
items.description: The Australian, who notoriously poisoned her family members, is trying to overturn her conviction.

items.title: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
items.description: The US actress, who has died at the age of 36, starred in the TV shows Heroes and Nashville.

items.title: US hiker dies after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna
items.description: The 30-year-old was on the active volcano when a thunderstorm developed, local media report.

items.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
items.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

items.title: Kushner hails 'very good' meeting with Netanyahu after Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
items.description: Donald Trump's Middle East envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

items.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
items.description: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

items.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump's bid to overturn E Jean Carroll  sex abuse case
items.description: The US president has already paid the writer over $5m in damages in the assault and defamation case.

items.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
items.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.
